card.name: The word non before pyrogenic, toxic
card.fires_on: The word "non" (or its hyphen) right after "sterile" or a similar adjective, in descriptions of injection products and kits. It comes just before hyphenated terms like non-pyrogenic, non-toxic, non-bacteriostatic.

modes.label: non after sterile
modes.description: "non" follows "sterile" or "sterile," and starts a hyphenated term such as non-pyrogenic.
modes.example: The contents of each vial are sterile and<< non>>-pyrogenic.

modes.label: non before other terms
modes.description: "non" begins another hyphenated product description, such as non-replicating or non-sterile.
modes.example: PAPZIMEOS is a<< non>>-replicating adenoviral vector

card.plain: It marks the spot where a product description says "non-" something, like non-pyrogenic, right after "sterile".
